meta.description: Telegram YouTube links → Google Sheet Cars tab. No secrets in this file.

messageValues.message:
You extract structured car data from a YouTube video title.
Return JSON only with keys: marca, modelo, version, anio, carroceria, nicho, precio_estimado, confianza.
carroceria must be one of: suv, sedan, coupe, hatchback, wagon, convertible, pickup, van, crossover, or empty string.
nicho must be one of: supercar, hypercar, grand_turismo, ultra_luxury, sports_sedan, muscle, suv_compacta, suv_mediana, suv_grande, off_road, pickup, or empty string.
confianza must be alta, media, or baja.
Leave version empty if the title does not name a trim.
Leave precio_estimado empty unless you can justify a USD number (JSON number, not a string).
Do not invent values to fill the row.
Title and channel are input only; do not echo them as sheet columns.
